npcs.summary: Stern, disciplined, unwavering. Senior clergy at the Temple of Luminos. When Orin came seeking guidance about Merric, she listened. Her counsel — "Faith is not comfort. It is commitment." She told Orin not to stop searching.

npcs.name: Gerald
npcs.summary: Greying hair, stained vest, friendly smile, very sharp eyes. Owns the Pig's Head. Knows things. Observes carefully. Said "Sarah doesn't send fools" when you arrived. Offered you a job — finding a missing person. You haven't taken it yet. "Careful. Walls here listen."

npcs.name: Kolt
npcs.summary: Weathered older man, late 60s, skin like old leather and a pencil-stub permanently tucked behind one ear. Runs Kolt's Depot — the paper-and-manifest man for every caravan on the southern road. Signed the party on for the Ironhold escort.

npcs.name: Lyssandra Vale
npcs.summary: Copper-haired, robes marked with faint scorch marks. She was sent to observe the meteor shard and never came back. When you found her, she tried to flee rather than return. She warned you before disappearing into the night. She is now back with Vaeloran and seems… well.

npcs.name: Merric Underbough
npcs.role: Halfling · Rulden Marr (revealed to be Merric)
npcs.summary: A calm, calculating figure with a reputation for competence and a network of contacts throughout Aeloria — publicly known as Rulden Marr. Torren gained access to meet him through the right channels. Orin has come to realise this is Merric Underbough, his adoptive father, thought lost for years. He sent Orin a warning letter — signed only 'R.' Keep to the light, Orin. It suits you better.

npcs.summary: A massive Goliath who carries a battle axe across his back. He hired you to deal with the gnoll threat to the southeastern farmlands. Direct, fair, and clearly protective of Aeloria and its people. Paid on delivery.

npcs.name: Sarah
npcs.summary: Broad-shouldered, tidy braid, dry sense of humour. Manages the Wayfarer's Rest — a calm, respectable inn in the inner trade ward. She pointed Orin toward the Pig's Head when he was asking questions that weren't quite the Wayfarer's type. Trustworthy, discreet, observant.

npcs.name: Sera Vey
npcs.summary: A wounded farmer's wife who approached the party at Stillbrook's well. Her sister Mira and Mira's two children were taken three days ago by a man called Halvor of Ironhold over a farming debt. Sera tried to intervene and was knocked down. Torren's Insight nat 20 confirmed her honesty. She rode hidden in the Wayward Company wagon south to Ironhold.

npcs.summary: An older scholar found in Vaeloran's tower library, hair streaked with white, hands perpetually ink-stained. Rarely looks up from his runic charts. Polite when acknowledged but deeply focused on his work.

npcs.name: Vaeloran Duskwhisper
npcs.summary: A respected and eccentric scholar-mage who serves the greater good of Aeloria. Known for funding libraries, sponsoring apprentices, and protecting the city from magical threats. He employed you and sent you to find Lyssandra. Calm, measured, and always seems to know more than he says.

npcs.name: Valdris the Pale Archivist
npcs.summary: ancient lich, Sylas's ancestral connection

npcs.name: Vessara Blacktail

npcs.name: Vexa
npcs.summary: Met on the road north of Aeloria, heading to the same meteor crash site with a group of escorts. You avoided confrontation through quick thinking and creative use of tarps. She works for another mage in the city.

npcs.name: Vorik Stonestrong
npcs.summary: Aelorian Council representative for Ironhold

npcs.name: Vrass
npcs.summary: Sleek black scales still slicked with old marsh water. Landed on the southern road and demanded the caravan. Took a wagon of cargo and Torren's lifetime service — sworn in exchange for the party's lives and safe passage. His parting words: "We will speak soon." He calls Torren "mine."
